name: Wee Ki Jie
title: Software Developer
bio: Software developer focused on applied AI. Currently gaining enterprise engineering experience at Cognizant while independently shipping AI projects.

experience.title: Programmer Analyst Trainee
description: Maintaining a Dynamics 365 CRM implementation serving thousands of users, supporting 99.9% SLA compliance under IM8 standards.

Diagnosed and resolved complex production incidents involving plugins, data errors, batch job errors, workflows, UI components, and security vulnerabilities by reverse-engineering and debugging legacy C# codebases.
Developed custom plugins, workflows, and third-party integrations to extend system functionality.

Managed application deployments and version control through GitLab CI/CD pipelines(SHIP-HATS), while identifying architectural limitations and collaborating with the team to implement long-term system improvements.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

experience.title: Mobile Application Developer
description: Developed a mobile app for biometric facial measurement using ML Kit's Face Detection API to support progressive lens fitting.
Used custom eyeglass detection and tracking model in PyTorch and applied OpenCV for lens contour extraction and optometric metric computation.
Created a real-time AR eyewear virtual try-on web app with Jeeliz VTO and gesture-based interaction via MediaPipe/Handsfree.js, enhanced by secondary-camera hand pose tracking.
